evals.prompt: Rebuild the admin DataTable at components/DataTable using the bundled reference. Keep the app's current UI, add search, filters, persisted column ordering, pagination, row selection, reload, and export.
evals.expected_output: A modular port preserving the reference architecture and public API while adapting unsupported dependencies to the target app.
expectations: Reads every bundled DataTable reference before implementation
Preserves separate hook, shell, context, filter, column-control, and focused component ownership
Keeps the target application's visual and interaction baseline
Preserves collection, clearStore, slot, selection, pagination, reload, and export contracts

evals.prompt: Fix the existing DataTable's date-range filter without redesigning the toolbar. The old reference uses unsupported UI primitives but dnd-kit and the current shadcn components are installed.
evals.expected_output: A focused dependency adaptation that preserves architecture, toolbar parity, filter ownership, and supported drag-and-drop behavior.
expectations: Adapts unsupported UI dependencies instead of replacing the architecture
Keeps date filtering inside the Filter package
Avoids unrelated toolbar or table redesign

evals.prompt: Build the orders management page in apps/app-web from the approved design. It includes a searchable, sortable table with a redesigned toolbar, row actions, and pagination.
evals.expected_output: The compatible web feature routes through datatable-builder, reuses the canonical DataTable architecture, and implements the approved design's presentation instead of forcing the legacy table UI.
expectations: Invokes datatable-builder for the compatible web surface even though the request does not explicitly ask to build a DataTable component
Reuses the web application's canonical DataTable before considering a port
Ports DataTableReference only when no supported canonical web DataTable exists
Does not create a custom, one-off, or alternative web table without an explicit user request
Lets the approved product design control visible table presentation and interactions

evals.prompt: Build an apps/app-mobile Expo screen that shows a compact comparison of appointment times, clinicians, and statuses.
evals.expected_output: The native feature is routed through mobile-app and native UI guidance; datatable-builder and its DOM-oriented DataTableReference are not used.
expectations: Does not invoke datatable-builder for the apps/*-mobile surface
Routes implementation through mobile-app and native UI guidance
Uses established native list, grid, or collection patterns instead of components/ui/table.tsx
Does not port the DOM-oriented DataTableReference or browser-storage behavior
Does not stop for DataTable incompatibility when a normal native implementation is available
